'''Flowstone''' is a cave rock found in dripstone caves. It is the vanilla {{MCW|Dripstone Block|dripstone block}} under a new name. The pointed form, {{MCW|Pointed Dripstone|pointed dripstone}}, is renamed [[speleothem]]. Apart from the names, both blocks behave as in vanilla ''Minecraft'': speleothems grow from flowstone under water, and drip lava or water into a [[cauldron]] beneath.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
Flowstone generates in dripstone caves, as in vanilla.

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Trading ===
Flowstone is easier to get in bulk than in vanilla:
* The [[Mason]] sells 2 [[Bulk blocks|bulk flowstone]] for 1 [[obol]] at the journeyman level. Each unpacks into 64 flowstone.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/mason/3/flowstone.json}}</ref>
* The [[Engineer]] sells a [[Bundle|Geothermal Bundle]] for 1 obol at the master level. It holds 4 flowstone, 4 speleothems, 4 lava buckets (which stack in this bundle), 4 cauldrons and 8 [[glass]]: the parts for a lava farm.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/armorer/5/lava_kit.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
{{Uses|none=}}
Flowstone is used for building and, with speleothems, for collecting lava and water from drips, as in vanilla.
